name: Yamagata (Gifu, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yamagata city emblem in blue and green: a blue and green stylised butterfly of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yamagata, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 January 2004.

features.role: Yamagata city emblem — a blue and green stylised butterfly of curved strokes
